editor.edit_advanced: behind an 'advanced' switch with a warning

applies.now: the server reads it at the next use
applies.next_login: the character sees it at the next world entry (it must be offline to edit)

applies.never: the server does not read it

signals: character_base.checkpoint_owner_id IS NOT NULL (session owns the character)

GET /admin/online lists the character (only when /admin/capabilities advertises it)
online_check.where: before the write AND inside the write transaction after SELECT ... FOR UPDATE OF c, a
online_check.stale: a crashed server can leave checkpoint_owner_id set: refuse; clear only with the server stopped

capabilities.probe: GET http://127.0.0.1:<mgmt>/admin/capabilities (mgmt 9090 live; timeout 2 s; 404 or no answer = none)

auth.token_file: <path readable by the editor via sudo -n>

capabilities.rule: use an operation only if it is advertised with online=true; send the expected old value (CAS) and a request id; otherwise fall back to 'log out first'

character_base.label: Character
character_base.server_writes: per_operation_locked for wallet / level / talent / zodiac / guild; checkpoint_fenced for position and HP/MP (flushed from session memory)

online.why: the server reads this when the character enters the world and keeps its own copy in memory for the session; the client is never told about a database change

character_base.offline: safe: the next world entry reads the edited row
character_base.while_running: safe for an offline character; the server holds no copy of it

revision.rule: bump the counter named in the field's 'revision' by exactly +1 in the same UPDATE; never write a counter back to a lower value; never touch checkpoint_owner_*

invariants: lock character_base + accounts FOR UPDATE OF c, a, then re-check offline inside the transaction

the character must have a character_economy_baseline row before wallet_revision or inventory_revision moves off 0; if it has none and both are 0, insert it exactly as PostgresCharacterEconomyBaseline.EnsureAsync does (baseline_source 'runtime_cutover', plus character_inventory_baseline_items) in the same transaction; if it has none and a revision is already > 0, refuse - every later shop / forge / bag command would fail
all CHECK constraints of character_base (31): currencies 0..2147483647, exp uint32, pet shed 2..8, warehouse 40..360 step 40, lifecycle timestamps, checkpoint owner pair
unique index ux_character_base_active_name_ci (lower(name) among active characters)
guild columns change only together with guild_members (Guild editor)

id.why: primary key; referenced by every character table

account_id.why: owner account (FK accounts, cascade); moving a character between accounts also needs account_realm and the one-active-slot index

server_id.why: realm (FK server); the snapshot only reads characters of the process realm (PostgresCharacterSnapshotReader.Core.cs:322-324)

name.rule: ASCII letters, digits, _ - . and inner spaces, at most 31 (32-byte packet fields keep a terminating zero); unique without case among active characters (index ux_character_base_active_name_ci) and not the name of a deleted character that can still be restored; stored only here (guilds, parties and rankings read it by character id); the name is sent to other players at world entry, so online renames are refused

GM.why: not read by this server; GM rights come from the DeveloperCommandOptions account allowlist in appsettings.json

camp.why: faction: quests, maps, guilds and NPC data depend on it; no server path changes it

profession.why: class: skills, talents and class-locked gear depend on it; no server path changes it

fighter_job_lv.rule: PlayerExperienceCatalog.MaximumLevel = 200 (S/State/PlayerExperienceCatalog.cs:5). DB-authoritative: kills read it FOR UPDATE (PostgresGameStore.Progression.cs:79-86), so an online edit is not lost, but the client and the session's stats stay at the old level until relog

fighter_job_exp.rule: CHECK uint32; keep it below the cost of the next level or the next kill levels up (PlayerExperienceCatalog.Apply)

scholar_job_lv.why: not read by this server (1.0 leftover)

scholar_job_exp.why: not read by this server (1.0 leftover)

curHP.rule: the session flushes HP/MP from memory (GameClientHandler.CharacterCheckpoints.cs, fenced by vitals_revision): an online edit is overwritten or makes the session's next flush fail

vitals_revision.why: fencing counter; bumped by +1 with curHP/curMP

zodiac_energy.rule: must not exceed the storage cap of zodiac_level (ZodiacEnergyCatalog.StorageLimits; level 1 = 1,000 ... level 30 = 1,090,000)

consortia.why: guild id; written only together with guild_members and consortia_job/guild_duty by PostgresGuildStore - edit it in the Guild editor, never alone

guild_duty.why: FK guild_duties; written with consortia by PostgresGuildStore

store_num.why: not read by this server (warehouse size is warehouse_capacity)

bag_num.why: not read by this server (the kit bag always projects 96 slots)

Map.rule: must exist in map_templates; position is flushed from memory (fenced by position_revision) - online edits are overwritten

Money.label: Silver
Money.rule: CHECK; needs an economy baseline row first (see invariants)

SkillPoint.label: Talent points
SkillPoint.rule: DB-authoritative (talent upgrade reads it under the row lock)

holy_suit_points.why: derived: recompute_character_holy_suit_points() sums the equipped holy-suit codes; recomputed after every equipment change

MaxHP.rule: base maximum; the session recomputes the real maximum from level, gear and buffs

Register_time.why: creation time; lifecycle CHECK uses it

mutetime.why: stock server ignores it; round2 /mute uses it (unix seconds) - edit through the live endpoint when advertised

wallet_revision.why: ledger key; bumped +1 with any wallet column

inventory_revision.why: ledger key; bumped +1 with any item change

checkpoint_owner_id.why: the game session that owns the character (online signal). Never written by the editor; clear it only with the server stopped

lifecycle_state.why: delete/restore go through the lifecycle command executor (outbox events, account_realm versions)

pet_shed_capacity.rule: owned pets must fit (the 10237 pet list throws otherwise, PacketBuilder.Pets.cs:160-185)

warehouse_capacity.why: trigger guard_character_warehouse_capacity: only increases, warehouse_revision must advance by exactly 1, and the deferred trigger require_warehouse_capacity_evidence needs a warehouse_expansion_settlements row. Give Storage Box Keys (item 4102) instead; client limit 160

warehouse_revision.why: may only advance together with capacity (trigger)

selected_title_id.rule: 0 or a title the character owns (character_title_ownership / atlantis_ / wonderland_ tables); the server's own selection bumps medusa_reward_revision (PostgresCharacterTitleSelectionStore.cs:67)

quest_completed_ids.why: legacy column, copied once into character_quests by a migration (PostgresSchemaMigrationCatalog.CharacterQuests.cs:52); the server reads completed quests from character_quests state 1

notes: edits columns the server never reads (store_num, bag_num, prestige, earl_rank, scholar_*, GM, status, quest_current_id, mutetime): saved but have no effect
edits consortia / consortia_job / guild_duty alone (desyncs guild_members)
zodiac_level 0..32767 and zodiac_energy unbounded; server range 1..30 and the storage cap
fighter_level_sealed without fighter_level_seal_revision, pet_shed_capacity without pet_shed_revision, selected_title_id without ownership check or medusa_reward_revision
no economy-baseline check before bumping wallet_revision / inventory_revision

character_items.label: Items (equipment, bag, warehouse)
character_items.server_reads: login_snapshot + per-operation locked reads (every bag/forge/shop command locks the rows it touches)
character_items.server_writes: per_operation_locked; each server change also writes character_inventory_ledger + command_inbox and bumps inventory_revision

online.why: the server reads this when the character enters the world and keeps its own copy in memory for the session; the client is never told about a database change

revision.rule: every item insert/update/delete/move bumps character_base.inventory_revision by +1 in the same transaction (one bump per edit)

invariants: lock character_base + accounts FOR UPDATE OF c, a, then re-check offline inside the transaction

the character must have a character_economy_baseline row before wallet_revision or inventory_revision moves off 0; if it has none and both are 0, insert it exactly as PostgresCharacterEconomyBaseline.EnsureAsync does (baseline_source 'runtime_cutover', plus character_inventory_baseline_items) in the same transaction; if it has none and a revision is already > 0, refuse - every later shop / forge / bag command would fail
keep the row id (item instance id) on move/swap - ledgers, baselines and sealed_pet_items refer to it; a delete + insert creates a new instance
one row per (user_id, item_location, slot_index): unique index ux_character_items_location_slot

item_location 0 equipment 0..23 (real slots 0-12, 15-20), 1 bag 0..95 visible (CHECK allows 0..32767), 2 server temp (never write), 3 warehouse 0..warehouse_capacity-1 (trigger guard_character_warehouse_item_slot)
prop_id FK item_templates (RESTRICT) and must be in the pinned official_item_template_content; stack 1..Overlap; quality 0..20 (client shows up to Q10), grade 0..25 (client G12), bound 0/1
an equipment slot takes only its kind (EquipmentSlots.cs); mount gear needs a mount and player lv >= mount lv >= gear lv (EquipmentEligibility.cs:120-150)
class_attribute1 / elemental_attribute1-2 only on the eligible gear list and grade 1..25 (CHECKs); holy sockets: value needs effect and level, socket count 0..6
after any change to equipped slots 0..11 call public.recompute_character_holy_suit_points(cid)
items linked in sealed_pet_items (packed pets) are read-only: they cannot enter the warehouse and bound ones cannot change owner (triggers)
write one character_item_audit row per changed item (source 'gwadmin-web')

notes: keeps row ids on move, audit rows, revision bump, holy-suit recompute, slot/kind checks; no economy-baseline check (see character_base)

invariants: append one row per item the editor changes; never update or delete rows

character_pets.label: Pets
character_pets.server_writes: per_operation_locked with revision CAS, durable command inbox/outbox

online.why: the summoned pet is a live world entity and the session keeps the pet projection; the client is not told

character_pets.while_running: safe for an offline character; a pet that fails a start-up validator does not hurt the running server but stops the NEXT restart

revision.rule: revision = revision + 1 on every changed pet row

invariants: pets of the character: lock the character row first (same as every write)
aptitude 1..16; talent_mask must equal f(aptitude) (CHECK ck_character_pets_quality_innate_talents); has_owner_merge_talent = bit 16

at most one carried, one summoned, one contributing pet per character (unique partial indexes); summoned => carried; opened_skill_slots <= available_skill_slots <= 12; active pet skills only in opened cells
new rows need hatch-rank evidence that matches a sealed pet_content_hatch_rank_steps row (trigger guard_pet_hatch_rank_evidence); aptitude and evidence are immutable afterwards
initial_savvy_source_version = 'basic-plus-scaled-growth-v3' and exactly 6 stat rows, or the next level-up throws (PostgresPetDurableCommandExecutor.Level.cs:52-64)
every change bumps character_pets.revision (and the stat / skill rows' revision) by +1 - the server's pet commands compare it (AND revision = @revision)
owned pets <= character_base.pet_shed_capacity
run the three start-up validators (gwadmin-web/reborn_validators.py) before COMMIT: one failing pet stops the whole server from starting (PostgresGameStore.cs:233-238)
sealed (packed) pets - activity_state 'sealed' / rows in sealed_pet_items - are read-only

notes: aptitude change uses a replica-mode window for one statement then re-asserts the savvy aggregate - keep it that narrow
